text:
Priya (Partnerships): Hey all — new thread for onboarding publisher accounts across AWS/GCP/Azure with a focus on region-specific trial entitlements and role mappings. Goal: clear owner list + a minimal ops checklist so we can start sandbox uploads next week.

Lee (Finance): Quick ask: do we want unified USD pricing in the listing manifest or localized prices per region? affects tax metadata and storefront visibility.

Priya (Partnerships): Prefer localized prices for EU/UK and SG to avoid FX surprises. For MVP we can default to USD for US only. We need SKU mapping doc.

Omar (CloudOps): I'll take publisher account setup + CI to publish artifacts. Items I need from teams: SSH key for AMI builders, service account for GCP publisher, and tenant id for Azure Partner Center. Also need the package manifest (mime types, entrypoint URL).

Nina (Legal): Trial entitlements: must capture opt-in to marketplace terms at first-use. For EU trials, include data processing addendum link. Also: mirror the refund policy in the offer description. I'll draft 2 short blurbs (trial T&Cs and data addendum) and add them here.

Gabe (Solutions Eng): We'll need example pricing for two bundles: Core (metered API tokens) and Enterprise (seat + support). Can someone confirm token -> unit conversion? i.e., 1,000 tokens = 1 unit?

Lee (Finance): We usually price metered as per 1K tokens. Confirming 1 unit = 1K tokens works OK. I'll sketch price bands and include tax code mappings for AWS/GCP/Azure.

Priya (Partnerships): Important: map store trial length per region. Proposed: US=14d, EU=30d (common request), SG=7d. Thoughts?

Nina (Legal): 30d in EU is fine, but we should block auto-conversion to paid plans without explicit consent. Add a clause: "Customers will be notified 7 days before trial expiry and must accept the subscription terms to continue."

Omar (CloudOps): For CI I'll add a smoke test step to validate provider billing callbacks:
```bash
# simulated marketplace callback
curl -X POST https://staging-hooks.redwood.ai/marketplace/callback -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"event":"BUY","sku":"redwood-core-starter","account":"acct-123"}'
```
I'll folder these under infra/marketplace/tests.

Gabe (Solutions Eng): On role mappings: we need 3 roles in the offer: Admin (full access), Billing (view + manage subscription), Developer (API key creation only). Can we ensure Azure's plan roles align?

Omar (CloudOps): Azure uses RBAC on offer plans, we can map Admin->Owner, Billing->Contributor with billing tagging, Developer->Reader+Custom. I'll draft the manifest snippet.

Priya (Partnerships): Also coordinate with hardware partners: for customers buying through marketplace who opt for a co-sell (e.g., pre-bundled GPU instances), we should add a support note in the offer. Not full bundle in MVP, just a link to recommended instance types.

Lee (Finance): Important: list price floor = $49/mo equivalent for Starter in USD. Nothing below that on any cloud listing. I'll put a tentative table in the drive.

Nina (Legal): Also: don't include the term "unlimited" in listing text. Marketplace auditors flag that. Use "no hard cap" if needed.

marketplace-bot: Ticket MRKT-118 created: onboarding/publisher-accounts. Assigned to Omar and Priya. https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/MRKT-118

Gabe (Solutions Eng): FYI, Solutions will run two customer-facing walkthroughs once we have an offer sandbox. I need the console purchase flow and an invoice sample from each marketplace.

Omar (CloudOps): Action items + due dates:
- Omar: create publisher accounts + CI templates (due in 4 business days).
- Gina (I/O): provide AMI builder key (cc'd offline) (due 2 bd).
- Lee: upload price bands CSV + tax codes (due EOD +3).
- Nina: trial T&Cs + EU DPA blurb (due EOD +2).
- Gabe: purchase flow test cases + invoice sample checklist (due 5 bd).
- Priya: coordinate partner note and launch readout (due 6 bd).

Priya (Partnerships): I'll schedule a 30-min cross-team sync next Thursday 9am PT. If you hit blockers, post status here. Thanks! :rocket:
